title: Reading Drill — Surveying heat in station platforms — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Surveying heat in station platforms — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The platform facilities lead in Cairnford received an old report about waiting passengers moving constantly between shaded areas. The report compared seats shaded at peak times, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the fixed photographs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered three weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include train arrival intervals. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed shaded panels over seats as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
